title: Institute of Human Combat

services.name: MMA Team
services.desc: Our Youth MMA program is perfect for our younger members ages 6 and up who are not quite ready for adult classes yet to learn and hone their skills, gain confidence, and focus on those aspects of martial arts training which will prepare them for success both in combat sports and life. Emphasis is placed on the pillars of self-discipline, respect, and responsible use of these skills and their use only being applied in self-defense or within the sport. Classes cover both gi and no-gi Brazilian Jiu Jitsu as well as the various striking arts found in our adult program. The material covered is the same as with the adult classes; just tailored to the pace and needs of a youth class. Typically

explain.meaning: Mixed martial arts, combining striking and grappling.

blurb: I believe in coaching people not a specific way. We are all unique and will be unique in how martial arts will work for us as individuals. I pride myself in finding the style, techniques and motivation that will work for each individual rather than treating everyone as the same.
